latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly convert scripts into animated explainer videos with cloud-powered AI.

- Upload TXT, DOCX, PDF, or SRT files (up to 50MB) to generate explainer videos with voiceover and subtitles.
- No video editing experience required—describe your requirements and receive a downloadable MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes automatic session management, free token generation, and simple credit system (100 free credits for new users).
- Supports export, credit checking, file uploads, timeline previews, and cloud rendering—all managed via clear, automated workflows.
- Ideal for marketers, educators, and founders seeking fast, professional explainer videos without manual editing.
